title: GET /api/v1/deployment-plans has no caller and fails every request with a TypeError
summary: Retire GET /api/v1/deployment-plans (DP-01) so it returns HTTP 410 via deprecated_bff_path_response(route="/api/v1/deployment-plans", replacement="/bff/deployments") without calling DeploymentPlanPort.list_deployment_plans(). Synchronize BFF_API_CONTRACT.md, scripts/bff_route_manifest_backend.py ROUTE_STATUS_OVERRIDES, services/control-plane/bff/contract_snapshots/backend_routes_manifest.json, and docs/bff/contract_snapshots/route-diff-baseline.json (486 -> 485 backend_missing_frontend via scripts/bff_route_diff.py --write-baseline). Migrate obsolete GET /api/v1/deployment-plans 200 assertions to 410 across scoped contract tests while preserving GET /bff/deployments 200 list behavior, GET /api/v1/deployment-plans/{plan_id} detail behavior, POST /api/v1/deployment-plans 410 ACTION_RETIRED side-effect checks, and composition_sources labels.

ac_2_sibling_and_replacement_routes_unch.post_deployment_plans: POST /api/v1/deployment-plans returns 410 ACTION_RETIRED without side effects
ac_2_sibling_and_replacement_routes_unch.get_bff_deployments: GET /bff/deployments returns 200 and serves active deployment-plan list
